quote_zh: Synthesis of enol ester of formula (II) from NMSBA of formula (III): ... The organic layer obtained was concentrated to obtain enol ester as off white crystalline solid. ... HPLC purity > 85%; Yield: 0.89g (65%); Melting point 152-158°C.
N, N’-dicyclohexylcarbodiimide (DCC) (0.8g, 0.004mol) were added under stirring at the temperature of 25-30°C
Tothismixture, 1, 3-cyclohexanedione (0.45g, 0.004mol) was added and stirred for about 2 hours at 25-30°C
To a clean and pre-dried 100mL round bottomed flask, dichloromethane (10mL) NMSBA
The reaction mixture was quenched with water (10mL) and separated the organic layer.
